statement: All integer relative X values strictly between L and R and all stock-allowed relative Y lie in a proved forbidden source rectangle. A valid source pair therefore satisfies dx<=L or dx>=R. Taking the largest L and smallest R over cog choices weakens that implication and remains necessary for each fixed non-cog profile. Assign a side flag according to its actual valid branch. For adjacent x-ordered cogs, right then left would imply dx_second-dx_first<=L-R, contradicting the proved minimum cog gap because R+gap-L>0. Thus monotone flags add no restriction. All eight bracket profiles, both insert orientations and all eight cog phases are covered. The source guards and micrometre stock grid remain the scope.
